final_name.description: Go to Rhodes and then Anthony Foreman, as the Blood Money Mission, 'The Railroad Contract' is a very good one to find capitale. Part 1 has some in a box at the campsite for example. You can collect it, then abandon to the main menu, and restart the mission to farm it.

all_descriptions:
Lake Don Julio, or near the fast travel post area of Lagras. Also in the lake by Owanjila Dam.
Try on the western edge of Saint Denis by the semaphore signal that's just before the railroad bridge.
Also at Blackwater in front of the butchers. [#1]
Use corn for bait, and try Cattail Pond to the west of Valentine. [#2]
The Dakota River, just west of the burned town of Limpany, is a good spot. Use corn for bait. [#3]

all_descriptions: Beef comes mainly from cows and oxen, but bison will also work.

final_name.description: Head to Manzanita Post, and then cross the road into the trees to the east. There is a patch just above the 'Z' on the map, and then another patch just a little to the NNW of those. [#2]
all_descriptions:
Fast travel to Rhodes, ride north and cross the railway line at the big red barn.
On your left are a few patches of Indian Tobbaco near to the left side of the road. [#1]
Head to Manzanita Post, and then cross the road into the trees to the east. There is a patch just above the 'Z' on the map, and then another patch just a little to the NNW of those. [#2]

Fast travel to Emerald Station and go north to the triangle of railway lines. There's some in the eastern corner, then follow the line around bend, some on the left, and some on the right, all no further than the 'O' on the map [#3]
